text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I went out with Daiichi Rubyâ

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Would you mind heading back first? I have 
some business to take care of before 
returning to the academy.
choice_data_list:
Since we're here anyway, I'll keep you 
company.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, we're going to watch a pro wrestling 
match, so it's not really an afterthought—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A company owned by my relatives is 
sponsoring it, and... Is something the 
matter?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ruby-senpai, why are you at this 
venue? Don't tell me you're here to watch 
pro wrestling... haha, no way!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I've come to watch the race.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Keeeh!?
choice_data_list: Of course you'd be surprised, huh...
You'd be surprised too, wouldn't you...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I am shocked, surprised, and astonished, 
desu... To think Ruby-senpai would do pro 
wrestling...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"However! Having friends around makes it 
much more fun! Let's watch the race 
together, desu!"

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Go-o-o! Mysterious Mask-! Make sure you 
win today too-!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list:
That tiny body taking on such a huge 
opponent... amazing!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Blowing away any handicap in size with 
polished speed and technique— Mysterious 
is simply amazing, *yes*!

text_block_list.name: Boy B
text_block_list.text: Ah! Watch out, Mysterious!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I am all right!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
As long as the crowd expects it of him, 
he'll overcome any pinch and claim 
victory— Because he's everyone's star!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
—Mysterious makes a comeback here! They 
launch a furious counterattack with 
relentless momentum!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, that pose is...! A special move is 
coming!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Using the ropes, she twists her body like 
a spring —and nails it!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Buenooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Mysteeerious! Mysteeerious!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~!! Today was another wonderful match 
de-su!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Standing back up no matter how many times 
you're pinned, and seizing victory with 
the cheers of the crowd— I just love it, 
yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I got carried away in the heat of the 
match, but wondering how Daiichi Ruby felt 
about it, I turned to look at her—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean! Watching such an 
intense battle, how could your heart NOT 
be moved, yes?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...No, some dust kicked up by the cheering 
crowd just got in my eye.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I shall advise the company representatives 
that focusing on cleaning the venue would 
be wise.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: T-That's some harsh feedback, yeeeess...
choice_data_list:
I thought for sure you were moved to 
tears...
Was the pro wrestling not to your liking?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Not particularly. Though I do understand 
it was a well-crafted show designed with 
customer satisfaction in mind.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, what a waste! Even though it's such 
a thrilling sport...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Let's go watch a different 
match next time!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
With El's recommended Special Card, 
Ruby-senpai's heart will totally melt, 
too-desu!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, such consideration is unnecessary. 
Good day to you, then.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Que!? Que!? Wait for me, yes! We're 
walking home together~, yes!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—the mixed exhibition match of Pro 
Wrestling VS Young Lady concluded with 
Daiichi Ruby business as usual.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...Clever, theatrical presentation, and a 
gripping race that keeps the entire 
audience on edge—"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
As pure entertainment, I believe it was a 
truly complete match.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's pro-wrestling for you! Such a 
passionate match has set Ruby-senpai's 
heart ablaze too—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No, I'm afraid I cannot relate.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gyaaah...! So freezing cold desu!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even amidst the heated match, Daiichi 
Ruby's heart remained unmoved. Watching 
pro wrestling with her only reaffirmed 
just how steadfast she truly is.
